Feedback: The onboarding workflow has too many manual steps and new users are unsure which access request path to choose.
The dashboard gives a helpful overview of pending items, but status definitions are not always clear.
Search results take too long to load when filtering by account or project name.
The permissions screen is difficult to understand, especially when assigning multiple roles to the same user.
Several users reported login issues after password reset, especially when switching devices.
The export to CSV feature is useful and reduces manual reporting work.
Analytics pages load slowly during peak morning usage.
The audit log is valuable, but filters are limited and make investigations slower.
The new navigation makes it easier to find reports and account settings.
Role names are too similar, making it hard to know which permissions each user actually receives.
The mobile layout is hard to use when reviewing dashboard items from a phone.
Support receives repeated questions about how to complete onboarding and entitlement setup.
Reports are helpful, but large exports occasionally timeout before the file is ready.
There is no clear confirmation message after changing user access, so admins are unsure if updates were saved.
The platform feels more stable after the latest release.
Bulk user onboarding would save time for large teams that add many users at once.
The dashboard should show aging items so managers can quickly identify overdue work.
The session timeout feels too short when working through longer reports.
Support agents need better search by user email, account number, and request status.
Removing access for terminated users requires too many clicks and creates operational risk.
Scheduled reports would reduce recurring manual downloads every week.
Dashboard refresh takes longer when multiple filters are applied.
Audit history should show who approved access changes, not just who submitted them.
Some settings are buried too deep in the menu structure.
A guided checklist would reduce onboarding mistakes and support tickets.
Admins need a clearer way to compare access levels across users.
The mobile experience works for viewing information but not for completing actions.
Export files should include applied filter criteria so teams can validate report context.
Users are confused when login errors do not explain whether the issue is password, access, or account status.
The dashboard is useful, but admins want configurable widgets by role.
